subject.title: feat: MCP Apps (ui://) Phase 0 — Control UI host + excalidraw pilot plugin

question: Should the first merged MCP Apps phase include the production sandbox-proxy host, and should the generic host/API be separated from the bundled Excalidraw pilot?
rationale: The upstream web-host architecture and shipped CSP make the proxy necessary for usable production behavior, while repository policy makes bundling an optional third-party integration a separate ownership and product choice.

options.title: Complete generic host first
options.body: Implement and prove the production sandbox proxy, approve the generic manifest contract, and decide Excalidraw promotion separately.

options.title: Complete the combined PR
options.body: Keep the pilot bundled but hold the draft until the production host works and maintainers explicitly sponsor both new surfaces.

options.title: Pause the direction
options.body: Keep the draft open pending a smaller architecture proposal for MCP Apps and plugin-declared servers.

recommendation.title: Complete generic host first
recommendation.body: Implement and prove the production sandbox proxy, approve the generic manifest contract, and decide Excalidraw promotion separately.

likelyOwner.reason: This member authored the implementation and proposed phase boundary, making them the strongest available owner to narrow or complete it.
